prompt.zh-TW: 海風麵包坊今年虧損，每股虧損 {{money:vars.lossPerShare}}，股價 {{money:vars.price}}。阿哲把股價除以負的每股盈餘，得到一個負數的本益比。他該怎麼理解這個結果？
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Bakery made a loss this year of {{money:vars.lossPerShare}} per share, and its share price is {{money:vars.price}}. Che divides the price by the negative earnings per share and gets a negative P/E ratio. How should he read this result?

text.zh-TW: 負倍數不具解釋意義，不拿來比較；N/A 是每股盈餘為零的情況
text.en: The negative multiple is not meaningful and is not compared; N/A is the case of zero earnings per share

short.en: The negative multiple is not meaningful

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。本益比回答的是「每一元盈餘要付多少錢」；公司虧損時沒有盈餘可以對應，算出的負倍數不具解釋意義。這和每股盈餘為零的 N/A 不同：N/A 是分母不存在，根本算不出來。
feedback.en: That is right. The P/E ratio answers how much is paid per unit of earnings; a loss-making company has no earnings to set against the price, so the negative multiple is not meaningful. That differs from N/A at zero earnings per share, where there is no denominator and nothing can be computed.

text.zh-TW: 把負的本益比當成零，表示這是最便宜的股票
text.en: Treat the negative P/E ratio as zero, which makes it the cheapest share

feedback.zh-TW: 你想把結果換成一個可以比較的數字，這個直覺可以理解。但零倍代表「免費拿到盈餘」，而這家公司是虧損；負倍數不具解釋意義，也不能改記成零。
feedback.en: Wanting to turn the result into a comparable number is understandable. But a multiple of zero would mean earnings for free, and this company made a loss; a negative multiple is not meaningful and cannot be recorded as zero either.

text.zh-TW: 負的本益比表示股價被低估，是趁低買進的訊號
text.en: A negative P/E ratio means the share is undervalued, a signal to buy while the price is low

feedback.zh-TW: 你把負數解讀成「異常便宜」，但負號只是因為分母是虧損；虧損公司要用別的方法看。
feedback.en: You read the minus sign as unusually cheap, but it only appears because the denominator is a loss; loss-making companies need other tools.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_g7s3}}是正確的理解：每股盈餘為零時本益比是 N/A（分母不存在）；為負時算得出負數，但不具解釋意義，不能拿來比較。{{option:o_h8t4}}把沒有意義的負倍數改成零；{{option:o_j9v5}}把負號當成買點。本章是會計觀念練習，不是投資建議。
explanation.en: {{option:o_g7s3}} is the right reading: at zero earnings per share the P/E ratio is N/A (there is no denominator); with negative earnings per share a negative number can be computed, but it is not meaningful and cannot be compared. {{option:o_h8t4}} turns a meaningless negative multiple into zero; {{option:o_j9v5}} reads the minus sign as a buying point. This chapter is an accounting concept exercise, not investment advice.
